{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tailored grey trousers, straight leg, full length to the ankle bone, charcoal grey #4A4D52, wool-blend suiting with a subtle texture

Matching grey blazer, single-breasted, relaxed fit with a softly structured shoulder, hip length, charcoal grey #4A4D52, wool-blend suiting to match the trousers

Silk-feel blouse, relaxed fit with a soft V-neck, long sleeves, cream #F1E9DB, crepe fabric

Ankle boots, almond toe, low block heel, ankle height, black #1C1C1E, smooth leather

Silver earrings, statement drop with a sculptural shape, polished sterling silver #C0C0C5

Slim silver bangle, thin, polished, sterling silver #C0C0C5

Structured tote bag, medium size, black #1C1C1E, smooth leather

Why this outfit works: The grey suit you asked for sets up a clean, polished business look that suits the office and the neat dress code. The cream blouse lifts the charcoal and brings softness near your face, and it flatters your deep, warm skin tone and dark hair. The silver drop earrings give the accent in jewelry you wanted, and the slim bangle echoes them without competing. Black ankle boots and a tote ground the look and suit the autumn weather, while the relaxed blazer cut keeps you comfortable through a full workday."}
